submitted.rationale: The light is 2.06 eV, which is below the BiVO4 bandgap. So the likely absorbers are copper vanadates such as Cu2V2O7 and Cu3V2O8, which have gaps around 1.9–2.0 eV. I focused on low-Bi, Cu–V-rich compositions. Index 88 (Bi 0.08, Cu 0.50, V 0.42), near Cu:V ≈ 1:1, gave the highest measured photocurrent: 2.5e-7 A.

rejected.reason: Measured 1.8e-7 A. This more Cu-rich composition is near Cu3V2O8 and came out lower than index 88.
Measured 8e-8 A. This Bi–V-rich, BiVO4-like region absorbs weakly at 2.06 eV.
